> 第18章 鸿门宴（第1页）
一张邀请帖送至陆家，牵动了众长老的神经线。
只要陆沉到场，赠五十枚下品灵气丹回礼。
明眼人一看，就知道这是鸿门宴，去不得。
但是，无论众长老如何劝说，陆沉还是决定赴宴。
原因无他，就为了五十枚下品灵气丹！
双木城最好的酒楼，今日被人包楼。
收到邀请帖的不止陆沉一人，还有一些大家族的少主，以及城中不少武道才俊。
这是周若雪的小心思，她要在全城的武道才俊前面，把陆沉的脸打得渣都不剩。
宴会设在四楼，赴宴的才俊们早早到来，犹如群星拱月般围着周若雪和江耀。
周若雪是城主之女，而江耀是紫云门弟子，两人身份如此高贵，他们还不及时拍屁溜须？
周若雪冷冷的道，随后起身，与江耀一起走到栏杆处观望，身后便是一大群人相随。
整个双木城，谁都知道城主废了陆沉，却又没废得彻底。
没有人知道陆沉为什么被废，但谁都猜得到，陆沉与周若雪之间，绝对有难以言明的恩怨。
“陆沉还敢来见周小姐，脸皮真厚。”
“近日有传言，说他的修为恢复了，不知是真是假？”
“即使恢复修为又如何，丹田和武脉废得差不多，还有当初的实力吗？”
“就算有，也跟周小姐相差太远了。”
这些人声讨陆沉，意在讨好周若雪。

他们又不是傻子，怎么会猜不到周若雪请陆沉来的目的？肯定是想打陆沉的脸啊。
只不过，他们还不知道陆家的变故，只知道陆沉在丹馆的事。
因为，大长老下了封口令，陆家的事暂不外传。
所以，他们并不知道陆沉拥有什么样的实力。
楼下，陆沉一身白袍，不徐不慢的走来。
一道身影从越过栏杆，从四楼一跃而下，稳稳落地，拦在陆沉跟前。
陆沉眼皮一抬，就认得这个人是孙家的少主，恃强凌弱的怂货，曾经被他揍过，今天这家伙又冒出来，多半是想找回曾经的场子了。
陆沉摇摇头，眼皮再抬，望向四楼，就见到周若雪正冷冷的看下来。
周若雪长得的确美艳，如今这种美艳在陆沉的眼中，犹如蛇蝎一样丑陋。
陆沉淡淡的质问，语气之中，有无尽寒意，也有无尽唏嘘。
以前卿卿我我，如今誓不两立，血仇必须血来还。
“你是双木城第一武道天才，还怕这点考验吗？”
周若雪表情冷淡，出言挤兑，“宴在四楼，你若能上来，我亲自给你斟茶又如何？”
陆沉淡淡回应，一句讽刺，直接点爆全场。

> Chapter 18 Hongmen Banquet (Page 1)
An invitation was sent to the Lu family, which touched the nerves of the elders.
As long as Lu Chen is present, he will give fifty low-grade spiritual energy pills as a return gift.
A discerning person will know at a glance that this is the Hongmen Banquet and cannot be attended.
However, no matter how the elders persuaded him, Lu Chen still decided to attend the banquet.
There is no other reason than for fifty low-grade spiritual energy pills!
The best restaurant in Shuangmu City was booked today.
Lu Chen was not the only one who received the invitation, there were also young masters from some big families and many martial arts talents in the city.
This was Zhou Ruoxue's little idea. She wanted to beat Lu Chen's face into pieces in front of all the martial arts talents in the city.
The banquet was held on the fourth floor. The talents attending the banquet arrived early and surrounded Zhou Ruoxue and Jiang Yao like stars over the moon.
Zhou Ruoxue is the daughter of the city lord, and Jiang Yao is a disciple of Ziyun Sect. They have such noble status, why don't they just slap each other in time?
Zhou Ruoxue said coldly, then stood up and walked to the railing with Jiang Yao to watch, followed by a large group of people.
Everyone in Shuangmu City knew that the city lord had deposed Lu Chen, but he had not completely deposed him.
No one knows why Lu Chen was deposed, but everyone can guess that there is definitely an unspeakable grudge between Lu Chen and Zhou Ruoxue.
"Lu Chen still dares to come to see Miss Zhou, he is so shameless."
"There have been rumors recently that his cultivation has recovered. Is it true or not?"
"So what if you recover your cultivation level? Your Dantian and martial arteries are almost completely destroyed. Will you still have the same strength as before?"
"Even if there is, it's still far from Miss Zhou."
These people denounced Lu Chen in order to please Zhou Ruoxue.
They were not fools, so how could they not guess Zhou Ruoxue's purpose in inviting Lu Chen here? He definitely wanted to slap Lu Chen in the face.
However, they don't know about the changes in the Lu family yet, they only know about Lu Chen's stay in the alchemy hall.
Because the Great Elder issued a hush-hush order, the affairs of the Lu family will not be revealed for the time being.
Therefore, they didn't know what kind of strength Lu Chen had.
Downstairs, Lu Chen, dressed in a white robe, walked slowly and slowly.
A figure jumped over the railing, jumped down from the fourth floor, landed steadily, and stopped in front of Lu Chen.
As soon as Lu Chen raised his eyelids, he recognized this person as the young master of the Sun family. He was a bully and a coward who had been beaten by him before. Today this guy showed up again, most likely because he wanted to regain his former position.
Lu Chen shook his head, raised his eyelids again, and looked towards the fourth floor, where he saw Zhou Ruoxue looking down coldly.
Zhou Ruoxue was indeed beautiful, but now in Lu Chen's eyes, this kind of beauty was as ugly as a snake or a scorpion.
Lu Chen asked lightly, with endless chill and endless regret in his tone.
We used to be close to each other, but now we are at odds with each other. Blood feud must be repaid with blood.
"You are the number one martial arts genius in Shuangmu City, are you still afraid of this test?"
Zhou Ruoxue had a cold expression and said, "The banquet is on the fourth floor. If you can come up, what if I serve you tea myself?"
Lu Chen responded calmly, with a sarcastic sentence that directly set off the whole audience.
